clips.title: The story
paras: Granis Swiftaxe is a dwarf warrior trainer stationed inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Known for his blunt demeanor and hardy training regimen, he mentors fledgling Alliance fighters emerging from Coldridge Pass before directing seasoned warriors to the city of Ironforge.

Found warming himself among the casks of the Thunderbrew Distillery, Granis Swiftaxe serves as the primary combat instructor for young warriors traversing Dun Morogh. He possesses the unyielding pride typical of dwarven fighters, showing open amusement and disdain toward non-warriors who try to catch his ear. Once a student demonstrates sufficient prowess in combat, Granis sends them up the mountain path to seek out master trainer Muren Stormpike in the Military Ward of Ironforge.
